tools.name: action_apply_manifest
tools.description: Applies a raw Kubernetes manifest (YAML/JSON) to the cluster after a safety review.

tools.name: action_execute_command
tools.description: Runs a shell command inside a pod's container — essentially `kubectl exec`.

tools.name: action_restart_workload
tools.description: Rolling-restarts a deployment / statefulset / daemonset without changing its spec.

tools.name: action_rollback_deployment
tools.description: Reverts a deployment to a previous revision after a bad rollout.

tools.name: apply_resource_patch
tools.description: Applies a strategic-merge or JSON patch to a single resource.

tools.name: cordon_node
tools.description: Marks a node unschedulable so new pods don't land there.

tools.name: delete_resource
tools.description: Deletes a specific resource by kind + name. Safety-gated.

tools.name: drain_node
tools.description: Evicts all pods off a node in prep for maintenance, honoring PodDisruptionBudgets.

tools.name: restart_pod
tools.description: Deletes a pod so its controller spins up a fresh replacement.

tools.name: rollback_deployment
tools.description: Rolls a deployment back to its previous revision.

tools.name: scale_deployment
tools.description: Changes a deployment's replica count.

tools.name: trigger_hpa_scale
tools.description: Nudges an HPA to re-evaluate metrics and scale now instead of waiting.

tools.name: update_resource_limits
tools.description: Updates a container's CPU / memory requests + limits without a full rollout.

tools.name: analyze_blast_radius
tools.description: Given a resource, shows everything that would be impacted if it crashed — dependents, traffic, data loss risk.

tools.name: analyze_capacity_trends
tools.description: Looks at CPU / memory / pod-count over time to predict when the cluster needs more capacity.

tools.name: analyze_cronjob_health
tools.description: Scans CronJobs for missed schedules, failed runs, and suspended jobs.

tools.name: analyze_daemonset_health
tools.description: Checks that each DaemonSet has a pod on every eligible node and all are Ready.

tools.name: analyze_dependencies
tools.description: Maps which services depend on which, so you can see the blast-radius of a change.

tools.name: analyze_deployment_health
tools.description: Checks if deployments have the right number of ready replicas and flags ones that are degraded.

tools.name: analyze_error_correlation
tools.description: Correlates errors across events, logs, and metrics to find the root cause.

tools.name: analyze_failure_patterns
tools.description: Looks for recurring failure patterns — the same thing going wrong over and over.

tools.name: analyze_hpa_behavior
tools.description: Looks at HPA scale events over time to see if scaling is jumpy, stuck, or well-tuned.

tools.name: analyze_image_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Scans the container images running in the cluster for known CVEs.

tools.name: analyze_ingress_health
tools.description: Checks every ingress: backend exists, endpoints ready, TLS certs valid, recent 5xx rate.

tools.name: analyze_job_health
tools.description: Scans Jobs for stuck ones, failing retry loops, and jobs that never complete.

tools.name: analyze_log_patterns
tools.description: Groups recent log lines into clusters so frequent error signatures pop out.

tools.name: analyze_network_connectivity
tools.description: Checks DNS, services, and NetworkPolicies for connectivity gaps.

tools.name: analyze_node_pressure
tools.description: Looks for nodes under CPU / memory / disk pressure that might start evicting pods.

tools.name: analyze_performance_bottlenecks
tools.description: Finds the slowest pods, the hottest nodes, and the chokepoints in between.

tools.name: analyze_pod_health
tools.description: Checks every pod for common problems — restarts, OOM kills, image-pull errors, CrashLoopBackOff — and summarizes in plain language.

tools.name: analyze_pod_scheduling
tools.description: Explains why pods are landing where they are — node selectors, affinity, taints, spread.

tools.name: analyze_rbac_permissions
tools.description: Reviews who has access to what in the cluster and flags overly-broad bindings.

tools.name: analyze_replicaset_health
tools.description: Checks ReplicaSets for the gap between desired and ready replicas and why.

tools.name: analyze_resource_efficiency
tools.description: Compares requested resources against actual usage to find overprovisioned workloads.

tools.name: analyze_rollout_risk
tools.description: Assesses how risky the next rollout of a deployment is based on recent history + blast radius.

tools.name: analyze_service_health
tools.description: Checks every service: has endpoints, selector works, traffic is flowing.

tools.name: analyze_statefulset_health
tools.description: Inspects StatefulSets for ordering issues, stuck replicas, and PVC mount failures.

tools.name: analyze_storage_health
tools.description: Checks persistent-volume claims — are they bound, are they full, are any in an error state.

tools.name: analyze_workload_patterns
tools.description: Clusters workloads by their usage profile — batch vs steady vs spiky.

tools.name: automation_create_alert_rule
tools.description: Generates a Prometheus-style alert rule for a condition you describe.

tools.name: automation_generate_runbook
tools.description: Generates a plain-English runbook for an incident type, based on cluster state.

tools.name: automation_run_playbook
tools.description: Executes a named runbook end-to-end, stopping for approval on destructive steps.

tools.name: automation_schedule_task
tools.description: Schedules a recurring task (a CronJob / alert / report).

tools.name: check_capabilities_all_added
tools.description: Flags containers that add the ALL or SYS_ADMIN Linux capability — essentially root with a different name.

tools.name: check_default_service_accounts_in_use
tools.description: Workloads using the 'default' ServiceAccount when they should have a dedicated, least-privilege one.

tools.name: check_host_path_mounts
tools.description: Lists pods mounting host paths, the classic container-to-host escape surface.

tools.name: check_image_tag_latest
tools.description: Workloads whose images have no tag or are pinned to :latest — unreproducible rollouts waiting to happen.

tools.name: check_ingress_tls_expiry_30d
tools.description: TLS certificates behind your ingresses that will expire within 30 days. Uses the backend's /tls-info endpoint.

tools.name: check_privileged_containers
tools.description: Flags pods running privileged containers or using hostNetwork/hostPID — the hardest escape-risks in Kubernetes.

tools.name: check_rbac_wildcards
tools.description: Role and ClusterRole rules with '*' verbs or resources — a standing invitation to privilege escalation.

tools.name: check_resource_limits
tools.description: Flags containers with no CPU / memory limits set (an operational foot-gun).

tools.name: check_root_containers
tools.description: Finds containers that may run as UID 0 because runAsNonRoot isn't set true.

tools.name: check_secrets_in_env
tools.description: Containers that read Secret values via env variables — prefer file mounts so logs can't leak them.

tools.name: check_writable_root_fs
tools.description: Finds containers without a read-only root filesystem — a defense-in-depth control you almost always want.

tools.name: cost_analyze_spending
tools.description: Breaks down where cluster spend is going right now — by namespace, workload, node.

tools.name: cost_forecast_spending
tools.description: Projects cluster cost N days out based on current growth trend.

tools.name: cost_identify_waste
tools.description: Finds the dollar-value waste — idle workloads, released volumes, over-provisioned requests.

tools.name: cost_optimization_plan
tools.description: Composes a ranked list of cost-reduction actions with estimated $ saved per action.

tools.name: detect_configuration_drift
tools.description: Finds resources whose live spec has drifted from what's in source control / last known good.

tools.name: detect_resource_contention
tools.description: Pairs of pods fighting over the same node's CPU / memory / IO / network.

tools.name: diagnose_certificate_failures
tools.description: Lists cert-manager Certificate and CertificateRequest failure events in the window, with reasons.

tools.name: diagnose_cronjob_missing_runs
tools.description: Explains why a CronJob didn't fire recently — suspended, concurrency conflict, or never scheduled.

tools.name: diagnose_deployment_rollback_needed
tools.description: Compares current revision to the prior one and tells you if the new rollout is worse than what it replaced.

tools.name: diagnose_hpa_not_scaling
tools.description: Why isn't the autoscaler scaling? Checks min=max, missing metrics, and unreachable targets in conditions.

tools.name: diagnose_ingress_404
tools.description: Traces an ingress path to backend service to endpoints and reports which link in the chain is broken.

tools.name: diagnose_networkpolicy_blocking
tools.description: Detects default-deny network policies and flags when a manual trace is needed to decide if a specific flow is blocked.

tools.name: diagnose_node_unschedulable
tools.description: Tells you why pods won't land on a node — cordoned, tainted, or under memory/disk/PID pressure.

tools.name: diagnose_pod_not_ready
tools.description: Tells you exactly why a specific pod isn't Ready — CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff, probe failures, or still Pending.

tools.name: diagnose_pvc_pending
tools.description: Walks through why a PVC is stuck Pending — missing storage class, no matching volume, or provisioner failing.

tools.name: diagnose_service_no_endpoints
tools.description: Explains why a service has no backends — selector mismatch, no pods running, or the service is headless.

tools.name: narrate_capacity_report
tools.description: Cluster-wide capacity: per-node utilization, headroom, whether a hypothetical new workload fits, trend direction.

tools.name: narrate_change_impact
tools.description: What-if analysis: given a proposed change, reasons through first- and second-order effects on the cluster.

tools.name: narrate_cost_report
tools.description: Cost breakdown by namespace or workload, with the single biggest driver and biggest cut opportunity.

tools.name: narrate_deploy_diff
tools.description: Explains in plain words what changed between a deployment's last two revisions and what users are likely seeing.

tools.name: narrate_incident_timeline
tools.description: Turns the last hour of events into a Slack-ready chronological story of what broke and when.

tools.name: narrate_migration_readiness
tools.description: What you'd have to move to migrate a namespace: workloads, PVCs, config, secrets, and known risks.

tools.name: narrate_onboarding_for_user
tools.description: What a specific ServiceAccount can actually touch — roles, resources, verbs, namespaces. Flags cluster-admin.

tools.name: narrate_security_posture
tools.description: CISO-ready posture summary — pod security, network policies, RBAC, secrets — with one next step each.

tools.name: narrate_service_dependency_graph
tools.description: Describes what calls a service and what it calls in turn, including the policies gating each hop.

tools.name: narrate_weekly_status
tools.description: An exec-friendly weekly cluster status — health headline, top changes, top issues, a few call-outs.

tools.name: get_cluster_health
tools.description: Gives a plain-English summary of whether the cluster looks healthy right now: node count, pod statuses, obvious problems.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Lists recent Kubernetes events — useful for 'why did my pod fail?' or 'what happened in the last hour?'

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Gets recent log lines from a pod, so you can see what the application actually said or errored out with.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Gets the full details of one specific thing (a single pod, a single deployment) when you need to see everything about it.

tools.name: inspect_clusterrole
tools.description: Everything about a ClusterRole: rules, who's bound to it, blast radius.

tools.name: inspect_clusterrolebinding
tools.description: A ClusterRoleBinding's subjects, the role they grant, and what it lets them do.

tools.name: inspect_configmap
tools.description: A ConfigMap's data, which pods mount it, and recent changes.

tools.name: inspect_crd
tools.description: A CRD's schema, scope, versions, and the custom resources it owns.

tools.name: inspect_cronjob
tools.description: A CronJob's schedule, last run status, active jobs, recent events, ownership chain.

tools.name: inspect_daemonset
tools.description: A DaemonSet's spec, which nodes run it, pod status per node, recent events.

tools.name: inspect_deployment
tools.description: One-call deep dive into a Deployment: spec, rollout status, events, owned ReplicaSets.

tools.name: inspect_hpa
tools.description: An HPA's target, metrics, current vs desired replicas, recent scale events.

tools.name: inspect_ingress
tools.description: An Ingress's rules, TLS config, backend services, recent events.

tools.name: inspect_job
tools.description: A Job's spec, completions, active pods, failed retries, events.

tools.name: inspect_limitrange
tools.description: A LimitRange's enforced min/max values per container / pod / pvc.

tools.name: inspect_namespace
tools.description: A namespace's pod / workload inventory, quotas, events, current usage.

tools.name: inspect_networkpolicy
tools.description: A NetworkPolicy's selectors, ingress/egress rules, and the pods it applies to.

tools.name: inspect_node
tools.description: One-call deep dive into a Node: capacity, conditions, taints, pods, events.

tools.name: inspect_pdb
tools.description: A PodDisruptionBudget's selector, minAvailable / maxUnavailable, and the workloads it covers.

tools.name: inspect_pod
tools.description: One-call deep dive into a Pod: spec, status, containers, events, ownership chain.

tools.name: inspect_pv
tools.description: A PV's capacity, reclaim policy, current PVC binding, storage class.

tools.name: inspect_pvc
tools.description: A PVC's phase, storage class, bound PV, and consuming pods.

tools.name: inspect_replicaset
tools.description: A ReplicaSet's desired/ready/available replicas, its parent Deployment, and its pods.

tools.name: inspect_resourcequota
tools.description: A ResourceQuota's hard limits and current usage per resource type.

tools.name: inspect_role
tools.description: A Role's rules, who's bound to it, and what operations it enables.

tools.name: inspect_rolebinding
tools.description: A RoleBinding's subjects, the role it grants, and effective permissions.

tools.name: inspect_secret
tools.description: A Secret's metadata, which pods mount it, type, and recent changes. Never returns raw values.

tools.name: inspect_service
tools.description: A Service's selector, ports, endpoints, traffic policy, and recent events.

tools.name: inspect_statefulset
tools.description: A StatefulSet's spec, ordinal pod status, PVC templates, update strategy, events.

tools.name: inspect_storageclass
tools.description: A StorageClass's provisioner, parameters, reclaim policy, and bound PVs.

tools.name: inspect_vpa
tools.description: A VerticalPodAutoscaler's recommendations vs current requests, and update mode.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: Shows you a list of things in your cluster — pods, services, anything. Tell it 'list pods' and it fetches them straight from Kubernetes.

tools.name: observe_api_resources
tools.description: Lists every API resource type the cluster knows about — including CRDs.

tools.name: observe_cluster_overview
tools.description: A dashboard-style snapshot of the whole cluster: what's running, what's broken, at-a-glance numbers.

tools.name: observe_configmap_consumers
tools.description: Which pods mount or reference a given ConfigMap.

tools.name: observe_custom_resources
tools.description: Lists all custom-resource instances of a given CRD.

tools.name: observe_deployment_detailed
tools.description: Everything about one deployment: replicas, pods, rollout status, recent changes.

tools.name: observe_deployment_rollout_history
tools.description: The revision history of a deployment with cause + timestamp per revision.

tools.name: observe_events
tools.description: Recent Kubernetes events — OOM kills, scheduling failures, rolled out, unhealthy, and more.

tools.name: observe_flapping_services
tools.description: Finds services whose endpoints keep churning — a sign pods behind them are unstable or being rescheduled.

tools.name: observe_high_cardinality_labels
tools.description: Would flag label keys with more than a thousand distinct values (Prometheus risk); backend index not yet available.

tools.name: observe_ingresses_by_tls_expiry
tools.description: Ingresses sorted by how close their TLS cert is to expiring.

tools.name: observe_metrics
tools.description: Raw pod + node metrics from metrics-server — CPU millicores and memory.

tools.name: observe_missing_probes
tools.description: Flags workloads whose containers have neither liveness nor readiness probes — you're flying blind there.

tools.name: observe_namespace_detailed
tools.description: Deep dive into a namespace — every pod, every service, every config, plus recent changes.

tools.name: observe_namespace_overview
tools.description: Zoom in on one namespace: what's running inside it, resource usage, recent events.

tools.name: observe_network_policies
tools.description: All NetworkPolicies in scope with their selector and ingress/egress rule summary.

tools.name: observe_node_detailed
tools.description: Everything about a single node: its pods, capacity, conditions, what's failing if anything.

tools.name: observe_node_metrics
tools.description: CPU / memory usage for every node right now.

tools.name: observe_node_status
tools.description: Is this node healthy? Are disks / memory / CPU under pressure?

tools.name: observe_noisy_neighbors
tools.description: Shows pods eating more than 80% of a node's CPU or memory — the ones starving their neighbors.

tools.name: observe_orphaned_pods
tools.description: Finds pods whose owning ReplicaSet or Job is gone — leftovers from a partial delete or controller bug.

tools.name: observe_pending_scheduler_events
tools.description: Shows recent FailedScheduling events so you can see which pods can't land and why — taint, affinity, or capacity.

tools.name: observe_pod_dependencies
tools.description: Everything a pod depends on — ConfigMaps, Secrets, PVCs, Services — and what depends on it.

tools.name: observe_pod_detailed
tools.description: Deep dive into a single pod: containers, status, restarts, resource usage, recent events.

tools.name: observe_pod_events
tools.description: Just the events that mention a specific pod — scheduled, started, killed, restarted, etc.

tools.name: observe_pod_logs
tools.description: Fetches logs for a specific pod with filtering by tail size or time window.

tools.name: observe_pod_logs_filtered
tools.description: Pod logs filtered to only error- or warn-level lines.

tools.name: observe_pod_metrics
tools.description: CPU / memory usage for one pod or across the cluster.

tools.name: observe_pvc_consumers
tools.description: Which pods currently use a given PVC.

tools.name: observe_recent_changes
tools.description: Every meaningful cluster change in a time window — rollouts, scales, config updates, failures.

tools.name: observe_resource
tools.description: Full details of a specific Kubernetes resource by kind + namespace + name.

tools.name: observe_resource_history
tools.description: Previous versions of a resource (if tracked), with diff between revisions.

tools.name: observe_resource_links
tools.description: What a resource links to and what links to it — the dependency edges.

tools.name: observe_resource_topology
tools.description: Graph view of related resources around a starting resource.

tools.name: observe_resources_by_query
tools.description: Finds resources matching a natural-language query, like 'failing pods in production'.

tools.name: observe_restart_storms
tools.description: Lists containers whose cumulative restart count is above threshold — the ones CrashLoopBackOff-ing hardest.

tools.name: observe_secret_consumers
tools.description: Which pods mount or reference a given Secret.

tools.name: observe_secrets_usage
tools.description: Cluster-wide view of which Secrets are actually used, stale, or referenced-but-missing.

tools.name: observe_service_endpoints
tools.description: The backing endpoints (IPs + ports) for a Service right now.

tools.name: observe_serviceaccount_detailed
tools.description: A ServiceAccount's secrets, bound roles, and the pods using it.

tools.name: observe_serviceaccount_permissions
tools.description: Exactly what a ServiceAccount can do across the cluster.

tools.name: observe_services_by_filter
tools.description: Services filtered by selector label, port, type, or recent issues.

tools.name: observe_storage_status
tools.description: Cluster-wide storage health — PVs, PVCs, classes, capacity, errors.

tools.name: observe_stuck_rollouts
tools.description: Surfaces deployments that have been 'progressing' for more than ten minutes without any new replicas becoming ready.

tools.name: observe_top_pods_by_metric
tools.description: Top N pods sorted by a metric (CPU, memory, network, or events).

tools.name: observe_unhealthy_probes
tools.description: Lists pods whose liveness or readiness probes are failing right now, grouped so the noise is denoised.

tools.name: observe_workload_health
tools.description: A high-level 'is my workload healthy?' check across deployments, statefulsets, daemonsets.

tools.name: observe_zombie_finalizers
tools.description: Finds resources stuck in Terminating longer than ten minutes because a finalizer won't release them.

tools.name: plan_backup_coverage
tools.description: Lists workloads that store data in PVCs but have no backup label or schedule — backup gaps you probably didn't know about.

tools.name: plan_cost_reduction
tools.description: Looks for idle nodes, orphaned persistent volumes, and over-replicated workloads so you can cut spend without pain.

tools.name: plan_drain_node
tools.description: Before you drain a node, see which pods would evict, which PDBs you'd break, and whether other nodes can absorb the work.

tools.name: plan_ha_upgrade
tools.description: Finds single-replica workloads that would die if a node blinks, and tells you how to make them highly-available.

tools.name: plan_image_pull_secrets
tools.description: Finds the same pull secret cloned across many namespaces and recommends a consolidated pattern.

tools.name: plan_pdb_coverage
tools.description: Deployments and StatefulSets with multiple replicas that lack a PodDisruptionBudget, with a suggested minAvailable for each.

tools.name: plan_psa_enforcement
tools.description: Which namespaces can safely tighten to restricted pod security? Names the pods that would need to change first.

tools.name: plan_resource_quota
tools.description: Suggests ResourceQuota limits per namespace based on what each one actually uses today, padded for growth.

tools.name: plan_rollout_safety
tools.description: Estimates how risky rolling out a new image tag is — who consumes this service, are replicas ready, what's the safe canary percentage.

tools.name: plan_scale_deployment
tools.description: Given observed load, tells you what replica count would put utilization in the healthy band — and flags when HPA is maxed out.

tools.name: who_can_do
tools.description: Given a verb + resource, lists which service accounts / users can do it.

tools.name: recommend_architecture_improvements
tools.description: Suggests architectural improvements based on what's running and how it behaves.

tools.name: recommend_cost_reduction
tools.description: Ranked list of changes that would cut cost with minimal risk.

tools.name: recommend_disaster_recovery
tools.description: Assesses DR posture and recommends backup schedules, cross-AZ spread, and failover drills.

tools.name: recommend_monitoring_improvements
tools.description: Gaps in observability — missing alerts, unmonitored probes, missing dashboards.

tools.name: recommend_resource_optimization
tools.description: Rightsizing suggestions: which containers should request more / less CPU or memory.

tools.name: recommend_scaling_strategy
tools.description: Recommends HPA / VPA / KEDA configuration for each workload based on its load profile.

tools.name: recommend_security_hardening
tools.description: Specific security controls to turn on, prioritized by risk reduction.

tools.name: recommend_upgrade_path
tools.description: Suggests a safe Kubernetes version upgrade path given current cluster state.

tools.name: assess_security_posture
tools.description: High-level check of the cluster's security hygiene — pod security, RBAC, secrets, network.

tools.name: security_audit_rbac
tools.description: End-to-end RBAC audit — cluster-admin bindings, wildcard rules, stale accounts.

tools.name: security_check_pod_security
tools.description: Scans every pod against pod-security-standards (privileged / baseline / restricted).

tools.name: security_compliance_report
tools.description: Maps findings to compliance frameworks: CIS, SOC2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS.

tools.name: security_scan_cluster
tools.description: Comprehensive cluster-level security scan covering CIS benchmark controls.

tools.name: security_scan_secrets
tools.description: Looks for secret hygiene issues: plaintext, over-mounted, old, unused.

tools.name: troubleshoot_deployment_failures
tools.description: Autonomous investigation of a failing deployment — pod events, rollout history, logs.

tools.name: troubleshoot_network_issues
tools.description: Traces a connectivity problem across DNS, services, endpoints, and NetworkPolicies.

tools.name: troubleshoot_performance_degradation
tools.description: Correlates slow-down symptoms with metrics, events, and recent changes.

tools.name: troubleshoot_pod_failures
tools.description: End-to-end investigation of why a pod keeps failing, with suggested fixes.

tools.name: troubleshoot_rbac_issues
tools.description: Traces 'Forbidden' errors back to the missing RBAC rule and who could grant it.

tools.name: troubleshoot_resource_constraints
tools.description: Correlates OOM / throttle / pressure events with resource requests + limits.

tools.name: troubleshoot_storage_issues
tools.description: Walks PV / PVC / mount / provisioner errors to pinpoint storage failures.

tools.name: export_topology_to_drawio
tools.description: Exports the cluster topology as a draw.io / diagrams.net file for slides or docs.

tools.name: resolve_resource
tools.description: Given a kind and a fuzzy name, finds the actual namespace + full name.
